current_version.description: Version of the running `loom`, replaced by the rollback.

install.description: What was restored, or would be with `--dry-run`.

DaemonRestart.description: What `loom upgrade` and `loom rollback` did to a running loomd after replacing the binaries.

oneOf.description: Nothing was replaced (`--dry-run`), so loomd was left alone.
No loomd holds the lock of the loom home.

`SIGTERM` was sent; a service manager restarts loomd on the new binary, otherwise the
next `loom` command starts it.

pid.description: PID of the loomd that was signalled.

oneOf.description: loomd runs, but `SIGTERM` could not be sent: it keeps running the replaced binary.

pid.description: PID read from the lock file, when there is one.

daemon.description: What happened to a running loomd.

install_dir.description: Directory holding `loom` and `loomd`: the directory of the running `loom`.

installed.description: `true` when the binaries were replaced; `false` with `--dry-run`.

pruned.description: Saved versions deleted to keep the most recent ones.

saved_to.description: Directory where the replaced version was saved (`<loom home>/versions/<version>`).

verified.description:
`true` when the signature of `SHA256SUMS` and the archive checksum were verified.
`false` for `--from` and `loom rollback` (local files).

version.description: Version installed, or that would be with `--dry-run`.
